                        <div>Confidence: <span id="stable-confidence">0.000</span></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="health-box health-canary">
                        <div class="health-title">Canary Model</div>
                        <div>Error Rate: <span id="canary-error-rate">0.00%</span></div>
                        <div>Avg Response: <span id="canary-response-time">0ms</span></div>
                        <div>Confidence: <span id="canary-confidence">0.000</span></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        
        <div class="chart-container">
            <h3>Performance Metrics Over Time</h3>
            <canvas id="metricsChart" width="400" height="200"></canvas>
        </div>
        
        <div class="chart-container">
            <h3>Traffic Split Timeline</h3>
            <canvas id="trafficChart" width="400" height="200"></canvas>
        </div>
        
        <div class="chart-container">
            <h3>Error Rate Comparison</h3>
            <canvas id="errorChart" width="400" height="200"></canvas>
        </div>
        
        <div class="status-card">
            <div class="status-header">Evaluation History</div>
            <div class="evaluation-log" id="evaluation-log">
                <!-- Evaluation entries will be populated here -->
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <script>
        // Initialize charts
        const metricsChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('metricsChart'), {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: [],
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'Stable Response Time',
                    data: [],
                    borderColor: '#27ae60',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(39, 174, 96, 0.1)',
                    tension: 0.4,
                    yAxisID: 'y'
                }, {
                    label: 'Canary Response Time',
                    data: [],
                    borderColor: '#e74c3c',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.1)',
                    tension: 0.4,
                    yAxisID: 'y'
                }, {
                    label: 'Stable Confidence',
                    data: [],
                    borderColor: '#3498db',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.1)',
                    tension: 0.4,
                    yAxisID: 'y1'
                }, {
                    label: 'Canary Confidence',
                    data: [],
                    borderColor: '#f39c12',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(243, 156, 18, 0.1)',
                    tension: 0.4,
                    yAxisID: 'y1'
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        type: 'linear',
                        display: true,
                        position: 'left',
                        title: { display: true, text: 'Response Time (ms)' }
                    },
                    y1: {
                        type: 'linear',
                        display: true,
                        position: 'right',
                        title: { display: true, text: 'Confidence' },
                        min: 0,
                        max: 1,
                        grid: { drawOnChartArea: false }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        
        const trafficChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('trafficChart'), {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: [],
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'Canary Traffic %',
                    data: [],
                    borderColor: '#e74c3c',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.2)',
                    fill: true,
                    tension: 0.4
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                scales: {
                    y: { beginAtZero: true, max: 100 }
                }
            }
        });
        
        const errorChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('errorChart'), {
            type: 'bar',
            data: {
                labels: ['Stable', 'Canary'],
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'Error Rate (%)',
                    data: [0, 0],
                    backgroundColor: ['#27ae60', '#e74c3c']
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                scales: {
                    y: { beginAtZero: true, max: 10 }
                }
            }
        });
        
        // Sample deployment data
        let deploymentData = {
            name: 'Model v2.1 Deployment',
            status: 'canary_active',
            duration: 2.5,
            trafficSplit: { stable: 85, canary: 15 },
            totalRequests: 1250,
            stableRequests: 1063,
            canaryRequests: 187,
            consecutiveFailures: 0,
            stableHealth: {
                errorRate: 1.2,
                responseTime: 45,
                confidence: 0.847
            },
            canaryHealth: {
                errorRate: 1.8,
                responseTime: 52,
                confidence: 0.863
            }
        };
        
        let evaluationHistory = [
            {
                timestamp: '2024-01-15T10:30:00Z',
                action: 'continue',
                trafficBefore: 5,
                trafficAfter: 10,
                reason: 'Criteria met, increasing traffic'
            },
            {
                timestamp: '2024-01-15T11:00:00Z',
                action: 'continue',
                trafficBefore: 10,
                trafficAfter: 15,
                reason: 'Performance stable, continuing promotion'
            }
        ];
        
        function updateDashboard() {
            // Update deployment info
            document.getElementById('deployment-name').textContent = deploymentData.name;
            document.getElementById('deployment-duration').textContent = deploymentData.duration.toFixed(1) + 'h';
            
            const statusElement = document.getElementById('deployment-status');
            statusElement.textContent = deploymentData.status.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
            statusElement.className = `status-badge status-${deploymentData.status.replace('_', '-')}`;
            
            // Update traffic distribution
```python
            // Update traffic distribution
            const trafficSplit = document.getElementById('traffic-split');
            const stableWidth = deploymentData.trafficSplit.stable;
            const canaryWidth = deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary;
            
            trafficSplit.innerHTML = `
                <div class="traffic-stable" style="width: ${stableWidth}%;">Stable ${stableWidth}%</div>
                <div class="traffic-canary" style="width: ${canaryWidth}%;">Canary ${canaryWidth}%</div>
            `;
            
            document.getElementById('total-requests').textContent = deploymentData.totalRequests;
            document.getElementById('stable-requests').textContent = deploymentData.stableRequests;
            document.getElementById('canary-requests').textContent = deploymentData.canaryRequests;
            
            // Update progress
            const progressFill = document.getElementById('progress-fill');
            progressFill.style.width = deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary + '%';
            
            document.getElementById('consecutive-failures').textContent = deploymentData.consecutiveFailures;
            
            // Update health metrics
            document.getElementById('stable-error-rate').textContent = deploymentData.stableHealth.errorRate.toFixed(2) + '%';
            document.getElementById('stable-response-time').textContent = deploymentData.stableHealth.responseTime + 'ms';
            document.getElementById('stable-confidence').textContent = deploymentData.stableHealth.confidence.toFixed(3);
            
            document.getElementById('canary-error-rate').textContent = deploymentData.canaryHealth.errorRate.toFixed(2) + '%';
            document.getElementById('canary-response-time').textContent = deploymentData.canaryHealth.responseTime + 'ms';
            document.getElementById('canary-confidence').textContent = deploymentData.canaryHealth.confidence.toFixed(3);
            
            // Update charts
            const now = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            
            // Metrics chart
            metricsChart.data.labels.push(now);
            metricsChart.data.datasets[0].data.push(deploymentData.stableHealth.responseTime);
            metricsChart.data.datasets[1].data.push(deploymentData.canaryHealth.responseTime);
            metricsChart.data.datasets[2].data.push(deploymentData.stableHealth.confidence);
            metricsChart.data.datasets[3].data.push(deploymentData.canaryHealth.confidence);
            
            // Traffic chart
            trafficChart.data.labels.push(now);
            trafficChart.data.datasets[0].data.push(deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary);
            
            // Error chart
            errorChart.data.datasets[0].data = [
                deploymentData.stableHealth.errorRate,
                deploymentData.canaryHealth.errorRate
            ];
            
            // Keep only last 20 data points
            if (metricsChart.data.labels.length > 20) {
                metricsChart.data.labels.shift();
                metricsChart.data.datasets.forEach(dataset => dataset.data.shift());
                trafficChart.data.labels.shift();
                trafficChart.data.datasets[0].data.shift();
            }
            
            metricsChart.update('none');
            trafficChart.update('none');
            errorChart.update('none');
            
            // Update evaluation log
            updateEvaluationLog();
        }
        
        function updateEvaluationLog() {
            const logContainer = document.getElementById('evaluation-log');
            logContainer.innerHTML = '';
            
            evaluationHistory.slice(-10).reverse().forEach(entry => {
                const logEntry = document.createElement('div');
                logEntry.className = 'log-entry';
                logEntry.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="log-timestamp">${new Date(entry.timestamp).toLocaleString()}</div>
                    <div><strong>Action:</strong> ${entry.action.toUpperCase()}</div>
                    <div><strong>Traffic:</strong> ${entry.trafficBefore}% → ${entry.trafficAfter}%</div>
                    <div><strong>Reason:</strong> ${entry.reason}</div>
                `;
                logContainer.appendChild(logEntry);
            });
        }
        
        function promoteCanary() {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to promote the canary to stable?')) {
                deploymentData.status = 'promoting';
                deploymentData.trafficSplit = { stable: 0, canary: 100 };
                
                evaluationHistory.push({
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                    action: 'promote',
                    trafficBefore: deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary,
                    trafficAfter: 100,
                    reason: 'Manual promotion triggered'
                });
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    deploymentData.status = 'completed';
                    alert('Canary successfully promoted to stable!');
                }, 2000);
                
                updateDashboard();
            }
        }
        
        function rollbackDeployment() {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to rollback the canary deployment?')) {
                deploymentData.status = 'failed';
                deploymentData.trafficSplit = { stable: 100, canary: 0 };
                
                evaluationHistory.push({
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                    action: 'rollback',
                    trafficBefore: deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary,
                    trafficAfter: 0,
                    reason: 'Manual rollback triggered'
                });
                
                alert('Deployment rolled back to stable version');
                updateDashboard();
            }
        }
        
        function pauseDeployment() {
            alert('Deployment paused. Traffic split will remain at current levels.');
        }
        
        function testPrediction() {
            // Simulate a test prediction
            const isCanary = Math.random() < (deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary / 100);
            const version = isCanary ? 'canary' : 'stable';
            const prediction = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
            const confidence = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3;
            const responseTime = isCanary ? 
                deploymentData.canaryHealth.responseTime + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10 :
                deploymentData.stableHealth.responseTime + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
            
            // Update request counts
            deploymentData.totalRequests++;
            if (isCanary) {
                deploymentData.canaryRequests++;
            } else {
                deploymentData.stableRequests++;
            }
            
            alert(`Test Prediction Result:\\nModel: ${version}\\nPrediction: ${prediction}\\nConfidence: ${confidence.toFixed(3)}\\nResponse Time: ${responseTime.toFixed(1)}ms`);
            updateDashboard();
        }
        
        function updateTrafficSplit(value) {
            document.getElementById('traffic-value').textContent = value + '%';
            
            if (deploymentData.status === 'canary_active') {
                deploymentData.trafficSplit = {
                    stable: 100 - parseInt(value),
                    canary: parseInt(value)
                };
                
                evaluationHistory.push({
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                    action: 'manual_update',
                    trafficBefore: deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary,
                    trafficAfter: parseInt(value),
                    reason: 'Manual traffic split adjustment'
                });
                
                updateDashboard();
            }
        }
        
        // Simulate real-time updates
        function simulateUpdates() {
            if (deploymentData.status === 'canary_active') {
                // Simulate some requests and metrics changes
                const requestsToAdd = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
                deploymentData.totalRequests += requestsToAdd;
                
                // Distribute requests based on traffic split
                const canaryRequests = Math.floor(requestsToAdd * deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary / 100);
                const stableRequests = requestsToAdd - canaryRequests;
                
                deploymentData.stableRequests += stableRequests;
                deploymentData.canaryRequests += canaryRequests;
                
                // Simulate slight metric variations
                deploymentData.stableHealth.responseTime += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
                deploymentData.canaryHealth.responseTime += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3;
                deploymentData.stableHealth.confidence += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
                deploymentData.canaryHealth.confidence += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
                
                // Keep values in reasonable ranges
                deploymentData.stableHealth.responseTime = Math.max(20, Math.min(100, deploymentData.stableHealth.responseTime));
                deploymentData.canaryHealth.responseTime = Math.max(25, Math.min(120, deploymentData.canaryHealth.responseTime));
                deploymentData.stableHealth.confidence = Math.max(0.7, Math.min(1.0, deploymentData.stableHealth.confidence));
                deploymentData.canaryHealth.confidence = Math.max(0.7, Math.min(1.0, deploymentData.canaryHealth.confidence));
                
                deploymentData.duration += 0.02; // Increment duration
                
                // Occasionally simulate automatic traffic increases
                if (Math.random() < 0.1 && deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary < 50) {
                    const newCanaryTraffic = Math.min(deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary + 5, 50);
                    
                    evaluationHistory.push({
                        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                        action: 'continue',
                        trafficBefore: deploymentData.trafficSplit.canary,
                        trafficAfter: newCanaryTraffic,
                        reason: 'Automatic evaluation - criteria met'
                    });
                    
                    deploymentData.trafficSplit = {
                        stable: 100 - newCanaryTraffic,
                        canary: newCanaryTraffic
                    };
                    
                    document.getElementById('traffic-slider').value = newCanaryTraffic;
                    document.getElementById('traffic-value').textContent = newCanaryTraffic + '%';
                }
            }
            
            updateDashboard();
        }
        
        // Initialize dashboard
        updateDashboard();
        
        // Start simulation
        setInterval(simulateUpdates, 3000);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
'''
        
        return dashboard_html
    
    def save_dashboard(self, filename: str = "canary_deployment_dashboard.html"):
        """Save dashboard to HTML file."""
        dashboard_html = self.generate_html_dashboard()
        with open(filename, 'w') as f:
            f.write(dashboard_html)
        logger.info(f"Canary deployment dashboard saved to {filename}")

def create_sample_models_for_canary():
    """Create sample models for canary deployment testing."""
    
    # Stable model - baseline performance
    stable_model = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Linear(784, 256),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Dropout(0.2),
        nn.Linear(256, 128),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Linear(128, 10)
    )
    
    # Canary model - improved architecture but potentially riskier
    canary_model = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Linear(784, 512),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
        nn.Dropout(0.3),
        nn.Linear(512, 256),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
        nn.Dropout(0.2),
        nn.Linear(256, 128),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Linear(128, 10)
    )
    
    # Save models
    torch.save(stable_model.state_dict(), "stable_model.pt")
    torch.save(canary_model.state_dict(), "canary_model.pt")
    
    # Create TorchScript versions
    stable_model.eval()
    canary_model.eval()
    
    example_input = torch.randn(1, 784)
    
    traced_stable = torch.jit.trace(stable_model, example_input)
    traced_canary = torch.jit.trace(canary_model, example_input)
    
    traced_stable.save("stable_model_traced.pt")
    traced_canary.save("canary_model_traced.pt")
    
    logger.info("Sample models created for canary deployment")
    return "stable_model_traced.pt", "canary_model_traced.pt"

def run_canary_deployment_simulation():
    """Run a complete canary deployment simulation."""
    
    print("=== Canary Deployment Simulation ===")
    
    # Create sample models
    stable_path, canary_path = create_sample_models_for_canary()
    
    # Create canary configuration
    config = CanaryConfig(
        deployment_id="canary_v2_1",
        name="Model v2.1 Canary Deployment",
        stable_model_path=stable_path,
        canary_model_path=canary_path,
        initial_traffic_percentage=5.0,
        max_traffic_percentage=100.0,
        traffic_increment=10.0,
        promotion_interval_minutes=2,  # Short interval for demo
        success_criteria={
            'max_error_rate_increase': 0.1,
            'max_response_time_increase': 0.2,
            'min_confidence_threshold': 0.7,
            'min_requests_per_evaluation': 50
        },
        rollback_criteria={
            'max_error_rate': 0.05,
            'max_response_time': 1000,
            'min_confidence': 0.5,
            'consecutive_failures': 3
        },
        max_duration_hours=24
    )
    
    # Create and start deployment
    deployment = CanaryDeployment(config)
    deployment.start_deployment()
    
    print(f"Started canary deployment: {config.name}")
    print(f"Initial traffic split: {config.initial_traffic_percentage}% to canary")
    
    # Simulate user requests
    users = [f"user_{i}" for i in range(50)]
    
    print("\nSimulating user requests...")
    try:
        for i in range(300):  # Simulate 300 requests
            user_id = np.random.choice(users)
            test_data = np.random.randn(784)
            request_id = f"req_{i}_{user_id}"
            
            try:
                result = deployment.predict(test_data, request_id)
                
                if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
                    print(f"  Completed {i + 1} requests")
                    status = deployment.get_deployment_status()
                    print(f"  Current status: {status['status']}")
                    print(f"  Traffic split: {status['traffic_split']}")
                    print(f"  Stable health: Error rate {status['stable_health']['error_rate']
```python
                    print(f"  Stable health: Error rate {status['stable_health']['error_rate']:.3f}, Response time {status['stable_health']['avg_response_time']:.1f}ms")
                    print(f"  Canary health: Error rate {status['canary_health']['error_rate']:.3f}, Response time {status['canary_health']['avg_response_time']:.1f}ms")
                
                # Small delay to simulate realistic request timing
                time.sleep(0.01)
                
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  Error in request {i}: {e}")
        
        # Let the deployment run for a bit to see evaluations
        print("\nWaiting for automatic evaluations...")
        time.sleep(10)  # Wait 10 seconds to see some evaluations
        
        # Get final status
        final_status = deployment.get_deployment_status()
        print(f"\nFinal Deployment Status:")
        print(f"Status: {final_status['status']}")
        print(f"Duration: {final_status['duration_hours']:.2f} hours")
        print(f"Total requests: {final_status['total_requests']}")
        print(f"Traffic split: {final_status['traffic_split']}")
        print(f"Consecutive failures: {final_status['consecutive_failures']}")
        
        # Get evaluation history
        eval_history = deployment.get_evaluation_history()
        print(f"\nEvaluation History ({len(eval_history)} evaluations):")
        for eval_data in eval_history[-3:]:  # Show last 3 evaluations
            print(f"  {eval_data['timestamp']}: {eval_data['decision']['action']} - {eval_data['decision']['reasons']}")
        
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nSimulation interrupted by user")
    
    finally:
        # Stop deployment
        deployment.stop_deployment()
        print("Deployment stopped")
    
    return deployment

## 196. Shadow Deployment Pattern

```python
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import numpy as np
import time
import logging
import threading
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, Callable, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from enum import Enum
import json
import sqlite3
from collections import deque, defaultdict
import asyncio
import aiohttp
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import statistics
import hashlib

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class ShadowStatus(Enum):
    """Shadow deployment status."""
    PREPARING = "preparing"
    ACTIVE = "active"
    ANALYZING = "analyzing"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    FAILED = "failed"

@dataclass
class ShadowConfig:
    """Configuration for shadow deployment."""
    deployment_id: str
    name: str
    production_model_path: str
    shadow_model_path: str
    shadow_traffic_percentage: float = 100.0  # Percentage of traffic to shadow
    comparison_metrics: List[str] = None
    analysis_window_hours: int = 24
    min_sample_size: int = 1000
    max_duration_hours: int = 168  # 1 week
    enable_performance_comparison: bool = True
    enable_prediction_comparison: bool = True

@dataclass
class ShadowRequest:
    """Request data for shadow deployment."""
    request_id: str
    user_id: str
    input_data: np.ndarray
    timestamp: datetime
    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = None

@dataclass
class ShadowResult:
    """Result from shadow deployment prediction."""
    request_id: str
    production_prediction: Any
    shadow_prediction: Any
    production_confidence: float
    shadow_confidence: float
    production_response_time: float
    shadow_response_time: float
    predictions_match: bool
    confidence_diff: float
    timestamp: datetime

class ShadowTrafficController:
    """Controls which requests are sent to shadow deployment."""
    
    def __init__(self, shadow_percentage: float = 100.0):
        self.shadow_percentage = shadow_percentage
        self.total_requests = 0
        self.shadow_requests = 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
    
    def should_shadow_request(self, request_id: str) -> bool:
        """Determine if request should be shadowed."""
        with self.lock:
            self.total_requests += 1
            
            # Use hash-based sampling for consistent behavior
            hash_value = int(hashlib.md5(request_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
            probability = (hash_value % 10000) / 10000.0
            
            if probability < (self.shadow_percentage / 100.0):
                self.shadow_requests += 1
                return True
            
            return False
    
    def get_shadow_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get shadow traffic statistics."""
        with self.lock:
            shadow_rate = (self.shadow_requests / max(self.total_requests, 1)) * 100
            
            return {
                'total_requests': self.total_requests,
                'shadow_requests': self.shadow_requests,
                'configured_percentage': self.shadow_percentage,
                'actual_shadow_rate': shadow_rate
            }
    
    def update_shadow_percentage(self, new_percentage: float):
        """Update shadow traffic percentage."""
        with self.lock:
            self.shadow_percentage = max(0.0, min(100.0, new_percentage))
            logger.info(f"Shadow traffic percentage updated to {self.shadow_percentage}%")

class ShadowAnalyzer:
    """Analyzes differences between production and shadow models."""
    
    def __init__(self, config: ShadowConfig):
        self.config = config
        self.results_history = deque()
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
    
    def record_result(self, result: ShadowResult):
        """Record a shadow deployment result."""
        with self.lock:
            self.results_history.append(result)
            
            # Keep only results within analysis window
            cutoff_time = datetime.now() - timedelta(hours=self.config.analysis_window_hours)
            while (self.results_history and 
                   self.results_history[0].timestamp < cutoff_time):
                self.results_history.popleft()
    
    def analyze_performance_differences(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analyze performance differences between models."""
        with self.lock:
            if len(self.results_history) < self.config.min_sample_size:
                return {
                    'status': 'insufficient_data',
                    'sample_size': len(self.results_history),
                    'required_size': self.config.min_sample_size
                }
            
            # Extract metrics
            production_response_times = [r.production_response_time for r in self.results_history]
            shadow_response_times = [r.shadow_response_time for r in self.results_history]
            production_confidences = [r.production_confidence for r in self.results_history]
            shadow_confidences = [r.shadow_confidence for r in self.results_history]
            prediction_matches = [r.predictions_match for r in self.results_history]
            confidence_diffs = [abs(r.confidence_diff) for r in self.results_history]
            
            # Calculate statistics
            analysis = {
                'sample_size': len(self.results_history),
                'time_window_hours': self.config.analysis_window_hours,
                'performance_comparison': {
                    'production_avg_response_time': statistics.mean(production_response_times),
                    'shadow_avg_response_time': statistics.mean(shadow_response_times),
                    'response_time_difference': statistics.mean(shadow_response_times) - statistics.mean(production_response_times),
                    'response_time_std_production': statistics.stdev(production_response_times) if len(production_response_times) > 1 else 0,
                    'response_time_std_shadow': statistics.stdev(shadow_response_times) if len(shadow_response_times) > 1 else 0
                },
                'prediction_comparison': {
                    'prediction_agreement_rate': sum(prediction_matches) / len(prediction_matches),
                    'avg_confidence_difference': statistics.mean(confidence_diffs),
                    'production_avg_confidence': statistics.mean(production_confidences),
                    'shadow_avg_confidence': statistics.mean(shadow_confidences),
                    'confidence_difference': statistics.mean(shadow_confidences) - statistics.mean(production_confidences)
                }
            }
            
            # Add percentile analysis
            production_response_times.sort()
            shadow_response_times.sort()
            
            analysis['performance_comparison'].update({
                'production_p95_response_time': self._percentile(production_response_times, 95),
                'shadow_p95_response_time': self._percentile(shadow_response_times, 95),
                'production_p99_response_time': self._percentile(production_response_times, 99),
                'shadow_p99_response_time': self._percentile(shadow_response_times, 99)
            })
            
            # Calculate improvement/degradation metrics
            response_time_improvement = (
                (statistics.mean(production_response_times) - statistics.mean(shadow_response_times)) /
                statistics.mean(production_response_times) * 100
            )
            
            confidence_improvement = (
                (statistics.mean(shadow_confidences) - statistics.mean(production_confidences)) /
                statistics.mean(production_confidences) * 100
            )
            
            analysis['summary'] = {
                'response_time_improvement_percent': response_time_improvement,
                'confidence_improvement_percent': confidence_improvement,
                'prediction_agreement_rate': analysis['prediction_comparison']['prediction_agreement_rate'],
                'recommendation': self._generate_recommendation(analysis)
            }
            
            return analysis
    
    def _percentile(self, data: List[float], percentile: int) -> float:
        """Calculate percentile of data."""
        if not data:
            return 0.0
        
        index = int(len(data) * percentile / 100)
        return data[min(index, len(data) - 1)]
    
    def _generate_recommendation(self, analysis: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """Generate deployment recommendation based on analysis."""
        perf_comparison = analysis['performance_comparison']
        pred_comparison = analysis['prediction_comparison']
        
        response_time_diff = perf_comparison['response_time_difference']
        agreement_rate = pred_comparison['prediction_agreement_rate']
        confidence_diff = pred_comparison['confidence_difference']
        
        # Decision criteria
        if response_time_diff > 100:  # Shadow is >100ms slower
            return "NOT_RECOMMENDED: Shadow model has significantly higher response time"
        
        if agreement_rate < 0.85:  # Less than 85% agreement
            return "CAUTION: Low prediction agreement rate, requires further investigation"
        
        if response_time_diff < -50 and confidence_diff > 0.05:  # Faster and more confident
            return "RECOMMENDED: Shadow model shows improved performance and confidence"
        
        if response_time_diff < 0 and agreement_rate > 0.95:  # Faster with high agreement
            return "RECOMMENDED: Shadow model is faster with high prediction agreement"
        
        if abs(response_time_diff) < 20 and agreement_rate > 0.90:  # Similar performance
            return "NEUTRAL: Models show similar performance characteristics"
        
        return "REQUIRES_REVIEW: Mixed results, manual review recommended"
    
    def analyze_prediction_patterns(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analyze patterns in prediction differences."""
        with self.lock:
            if len(self.results_history) < 100:
                return {'status': 'insufficient_data'}
            
            # Group by prediction agreement
            agreements = defaultdict(list)
            disagreements = defaultdict(list)
            
            for result in self.results_history:
                if result.predictions_match:
                    agreements['confidence_diffs'].append(abs(result.confidence_diff))
                    agreements['response_times'].append(result.shadow_response_time)
                else:
                    disagreements['confidence_diffs'].append(abs(result.confidence_diff))
                    disagreements['response_times'].append(result.shadow_response_time)
                    disagreements['production_predictions'].append(result.production_prediction)
                    disagreements['shadow_predictions'].append(result.shadow_prediction)
            
            analysis = {
                'agreement_cases': len(agreements['confidence_diffs']),
                'disagreement_cases': len(disagreements['confidence_diffs']),
                'agreement_rate': len(agreements['confidence_
```python
                'agreement_rate': len(agreements['confidence_diffs']) / len(self.results_history),
                'avg_confidence_diff_when_agree': statistics.mean(agreements['confidence_diffs']) if agreements['confidence_diffs'] else 0,
                'avg_confidence_diff_when_disagree': statistics.mean(disagreements['confidence_diffs']) if disagreements['confidence_diffs'] else 0
            }
            
            # Analyze disagreement patterns
            if disagreements['production_predictions'] and disagreements['shadow_predictions']:
                prod_pred_dist = defaultdict(int)
                shadow_pred_dist = defaultdict(int)
                
                for prod_pred, shadow_pred in zip(disagreements['production_predictions'], disagreements['shadow_predictions']):
                    prod_pred_dist[prod_pred] += 1
                    shadow_pred_dist[shadow_pred] += 1
                
                analysis['disagreement_patterns'] = {
                    'production_prediction_distribution': dict(prod_pred_dist),
                    'shadow_prediction_distribution': dict(shadow_pred_dist),
                    'most_common_production_prediction': max(prod_pred_dist, key=prod_pred_dist.get) if prod_pred_dist else None,
                    'most_common_shadow_prediction': max(shadow_pred_dist, key=shadow_pred_dist.get) if shadow_pred_dist else None
                }
            
            return analysis

class ShadowDeployment:
    """Main shadow deployment orchestrator."""
    
    def __init__(self, config: ShadowConfig, device: str = 'cpu'):
        self.config = config
        self.device = torch.device(device)
        self.status = ShadowStatus.PREPARING
        
        # Components
        self.traffic_controller = ShadowTrafficController(config.shadow_traffic_percentage)
        self.analyzer = ShadowAnalyzer(config)
        
        # Models
        self.production_model = None
        self.shadow_model = None
        
        # State tracking
        self.deployment_start_time = None
        self.request_count = 0
        
        # Background processing
        self.shadow_queue = asyncio.Queue()
        self.processing_tasks = []
        self.shutdown_event = asyncio.Event()
        
        # Database for logging
        self.db_path = f"shadow_{config.deployment_id}.db"
        self._init_database()
    
    def _init_database(self):
        """Initialize database for shadow deployment logging."""
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shadow_results (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    request_id TEXT,
                    production_prediction TEXT,
                    shadow_prediction TEXT,
                    production_confidence REAL,
                    shadow_confidence REAL,
                    production_response_time REAL,
                    shadow_response_time REAL,
                    predictions_match INTEGER,
                    confidence_diff REAL,
                    timestamp TIMESTAMP
                )
            """)
            
            conn.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deployment_events (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    timestamp TIMESTAMP,
                    event_type TEXT,
                    event_data TEXT
                )
            """)
            conn.commit()
    
    def _load_model(self, model_path: str) -> nn.Module:
        """Load model from path."""
        if model_path.endswith('.pt') and 'traced' in model_path:
            model = torch.jit.load(model_path, map_location=self.device)
        else:
            # For demo, create a simple model
            model = self._create_demo_model()
            try:
                state_dict = torch.load(model_path, map_location=self.device)
                model.load_state_dict(state_dict)
            except:
                logger.warning(f"Could not load weights from {model_path}, using random weights")
        
        model.eval()
        model.to(self.device)
        return model
    
    def _create_demo_model(self) -> nn.Module:
        """Create demo model for testing."""
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(784, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 10)
        )
    
    async def start_deployment(self):
        """Start the shadow deployment."""
        logger.info(f"Starting shadow deployment: {self.config.name}")
        
        try:
            # Load models
            self.production_model = self._load_model(self.config.production_model_path)
            self.shadow_model = self._load_model(self.config.shadow_model_path)
            
            # Update status
            self.status = ShadowStatus.ACTIVE
            self.deployment_start_time = datetime.now()
            
            # Start background processing
            await self._start_background_processing()
            
            # Log deployment start
            self._log_event("deployment_started", {
                'config': asdict(self.config),
                'start_time': self.deployment_start_time.isoformat()
            })
            
            logger.info(f"Shadow deployment started with {self.config.shadow_traffic_percentage}% traffic shadowing")
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.status = ShadowStatus.FAILED
            logger.error(f"Failed to start shadow deployment: {e}")
            raise
    
    async def _start_background_processing(self):
        """Start background tasks for processing shadow requests."""
        # Create multiple worker tasks for parallel processing
        num_workers = min(4, max(1, int(self.config.shadow_traffic_percentage / 25)))
        
        for i in range(num_workers):
            task = asyncio.create_task(self._shadow_processing_worker(f"worker_{i}"))
            self.processing_tasks.append(task)
        
        logger.info(f"Started {num_workers} shadow processing workers")
    
    async def _shadow_processing_worker(self, worker_id: str):
        """Background worker for processing shadow requests."""
        while not self.shutdown_event.is_set():
            try:
                # Wait for shadow request with timeout
                shadow_request = await asyncio.wait_for(
                    self.shadow_queue.get(), timeout=1.0
                )
                
                # Process shadow request
                await self._process_shadow_request(shadow_request)
                
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                continue
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Shadow worker {worker_id} error: {e}")
    
    async def _process_shadow_request(self, shadow_request: ShadowRequest):
        """Process a shadow request asynchronously."""
        try:
            # Run shadow prediction
            start_time = time.time()
            
            with torch.no_grad():
                tensor_data = torch.tensor(
                    shadow_request.input_data, 
                    dtype=torch.float32, 
                    device=self.device
                )
                
                if len(tensor_data.shape) == 1:
                    tensor_data = tensor_data.unsqueeze(0)
                
                # Shadow model prediction
                shadow_logits = self.shadow_model(tensor_data)
                shadow_probs = torch.softmax(shadow_logits, dim=1)
                shadow_confidence, shadow_prediction = torch.max(shadow_probs, dim=1)
            
            shadow_response_time = time.time() - start_time
            
            # Get production result from metadata (already computed)
            production_prediction = shadow_request.metadata['production_prediction']
            production_confidence = shadow_request.metadata['production_confidence']
            production_response_time = shadow_request.metadata['production_response_time']
            
            # Compare results
            predictions_match = (production_prediction == shadow_prediction.item())
            confidence_diff = shadow_confidence.item() - production_confidence
            
            # Create result
            result = ShadowResult(
                request_id=shadow_request.request_id,
                production_prediction=production_prediction,
                shadow_prediction=shadow_prediction.item(),
                production_confidence=production_confidence,
                shadow_confidence=shadow_confidence.item(),
                production_response_time=production_response_time,
                shadow_response_time=shadow_response_time,
                predictions_match=predictions_match,
                confidence_diff=confidence_diff,
                timestamp=datetime.now()
            )
            
            # Record result
            self.analyzer.record_result(result)
            self._log_shadow_result(result)
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Error processing shadow request {shadow_request.request_id}: {e}")
    
    async def predict(self, data: np.ndarray, user_id: str, request_id: str = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Make prediction with shadow deployment."""
        if self.status != ShadowStatus.ACTIVE:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Shadow deployment not active, status: {self.status}")
        
        if request_id is None:
            request_id = f"req_{int(time.time() * 1000000)}"
        
        self.request_count += 1
        
        # Always run production prediction
        start_time = time.time()
        
        try:
            # Preprocess data
            if isinstance(data, np.ndarray):
                tensor_data = torch.tensor(data, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
            else:
                tensor_data = torch.tensor(np.array(data), dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
            
            if len(tensor_data.shape) == 1:
                tensor_data = tensor_data.unsqueeze(0)
            
            # Production prediction
            with torch.no_grad():
                production_logits = self.production_model(tensor_data)
                production_probs = torch.softmax(production_logits, dim=1)
                production_confidence, production_prediction = torch.max(production_probs, dim=1)
            
            production_response_time = time.time() - start_time
            
            # Check if this request should be shadowed
            should_shadow = self.traffic_controller.should_shadow_request(request_id)
            
            if should_shadow:
                # Queue shadow request for async processing
                shadow_request = ShadowRequest(
                    request_id=request_id,
                    user_id=user_id,
                    input_data=data,
                    timestamp=datetime.now(),
                    metadata={
                        'production_prediction': production_prediction.item(),
                        'production_confidence': production_confidence.item(),
                        'production_response_time': production_response_time
                    }
                )
                
                # Non-blocking queue put
                try:
                    self.shadow_queue.put_nowait(shadow_request)
                except asyncio.QueueFull:
                    logger.warning(f"Shadow queue full, dropping request {request_id}")
            
            return {
                'prediction': production_prediction.item(),
                'confidence': production_confidence.item(),
                'response_time': production_response_time,
                'request_id': request_id,
                'shadowed': should_shadow
            }
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Production prediction error: {e}")
            raise
    
    def _log_shadow_result(self, result: ShadowResult):
        """Log shadow result to database."""
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT INTO shadow_results 
                (request_id, production_prediction, shadow_prediction, 
                 production_confidence, shadow_confidence, production_response_time, 
                 shadow_response_time, predictions_match, confidence_diff, timestamp)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, (
                result.request_id,
                json.dumps(result.production_prediction),
                json.dumps(result.shadow_prediction),
                result.production_confidence,
                result.shadow_confidence,
                result.production_response_time,
                result.shadow_response_time,
                1 if result.predictions_match else 0,
                result.confidence_diff,
                result.timestamp
            ))
            conn.commit()
    
    def _log_event(self, event_type: str, event_data: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Log deployment event."""
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            conn.execute("""
                INSERT INTO deployment_events (timestamp, event_type, event_data)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?)
            """, (datetime.now(), event_type, json.dumps(event_data, default=str)))
            conn.commit()
    
    def get_deployment_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get current deployment status."""
        traffic_stats = self.traffic_controller.get_shadow_stats()
        analysis = self.analyzer.analyze_performance_differences()
        
        duration = None
        if self.deployment_start_time:
            duration = (datetime.now() - self.deployment_start_time).total_seconds() / 3600
        
        return {
            'deployment_id': self.config.deployment_id,
            'name': self.config.name,
            'status': self.status.value,
            'duration_hours': duration,
            'total_requests': self.request_count,
            'traffic_stats': traffic_stats,
            'queue_size': self.shadow_queue.qsize() if hasattr(self.shadow_queue, 'qsize') else 0,
            'analysis': analysis,
            'config': asdict(self.config)
        }
    
    def get_detailed_analysis(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get detailed analysis of shadow deployment."""
        performance_analysis = self.analyzer.analyze_performance_differences()
        pattern_analysis = self.analyzer.analyze_prediction_patterns()
        
        return {
            'performance_analysis': performance_analysis,
            'pattern_analysis': pattern_analysis,
            'deployment_info': {
                'start_time': self.deployment_start_time.isoformat() if self.deployment_start_time else None,
                'duration_hours': (datetime.now() - self.deployment_start_time).total_seconds() / 3600 if self.deployment_start_time else 0,
                'total_requests': self.request_count,
                'shadow_requests': self.traffic_controller.get_shadow_stats()['shadow_requests']
            }
        }
    
    async def stop_deployment(self):
        """Stop the shadow deployment."""
        logger.info("Stopping shadow deployment")
        
        self.status = ShadowStatus.ANALYZING
        self.shutdown_event.set()
        
        # Wait for background tasks to complete
        if self.processing_tasks:
            await asyncio.gather(*self.processing_tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        self.status = ShadowStatus.COMPLETED
        
        # Log final analysis
        final_analysis = self.get_detailed_analysis()
        self._log_event("deployment_completed", final_analysis)
        
        logger.info("Shadow deployment stopped")

        function updateDashboard() {

            // Update traffic metrics
            document.getElementById('total-requests').textContent = deploymentData.totalRequests.toLocaleString();
            document.getElementById('shadow-requests').textContent = deploymentData.shadowRequests.toLocaleString();
            document.getElementById('shadow-rate').textContent = deploymentData.shadowRate.toFixed(1) + '%';
            document.getElementById('queue-size').textContent = deploymentData.queueSize;
            
            // Update shadow progress
            const shadowProgress = document.getElementById('shadow-progress');
            shadowProgress.style.width = deploymentData.shadowRate + '%';
            
            // Update agreement metrics
            document.getElementById('agreement-rate').textContent = deploymentData.agreementRate.toFixed(1) + '%';
            document.getElementById('matching-predictions').textContent = deploymentData.matchingPredictions.toLocaleString();
            document.getElementById('disagreements').textContent = deploymentData.disagreements.toLocaleString();
            document.getElementById('avg-confidence-diff').textContent = deploymentData.avgConfidenceDiff.toFixed(3);
            
            // Update performance comparison
            document.getElementById('prod-response-time').textContent = deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgResponseTime + 'ms';
            document.getElementById('prod-confidence').textContent = deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgConfidence.toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('prod-p95').textContent = deploymentData.productionMetrics.p95ResponseTime + 'ms';
            
            document.getElementById('shadow-response-time').textContent = deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgResponseTime + 'ms';
            document.getElementById('shadow-confidence').textContent = deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgConfidence.toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('shadow-p95').textContent = deploymentData.shadowMetrics.p95ResponseTime + 'ms';
            
            // Calculate and display response time difference
            const timeDiff = deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgResponseTime - deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgResponseTime;
            const timeDiffPercent = (timeDiff / deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgResponseTime * 100).toFixed(1);
            const timeDiffSign = timeDiff >= 0 ? '+' : '';
            document.getElementById('response-time-diff').textContent = `${timeDiffSign}${timeDiff}ms (${timeDiffSign}${timeDiffPercent}%)`;
            
            // Update recommendation
            const recommendationBox = document.getElementById('recommendation-box');
            const recommendationText = document.getElementById('recommendation-text');
            
            recommendationBox.className = `recommendation-box recommendation-${deploymentData.recommendationType}`;
            recommendationText.textContent = deploymentData.recommendation;
            
            document.getElementById('sample-size').textContent = deploymentData.sampleSize.toLocaleString();
            document.getElementById('analysis-window').textContent = deploymentData.analysisWindow + ' hours';
            
            // Update charts
            const now = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            
            // Response time chart
            responseTimeChart.data.labels.push(now);
            responseTimeChart.data.datasets[0].data.push(deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgResponseTime);
            responseTimeChart.data.datasets[1].data.push(deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgResponseTime);
            
            // Agreement chart
            agreementChart.data.labels.push(now);
            agreementChart.data.datasets[0].data.push(deploymentData.agreementRate);
            
            // Queue chart
            queueChart.data.labels.push(now);
            queueChart.data.datasets[0].data.push(deploymentData.queueSize);
            
            // Keep only last 20 data points
            if (responseTimeChart.data.labels.length > 20) {
                responseTimeChart.data.labels.shift();
                responseTimeChart.data.datasets.forEach(dataset => dataset.data.shift());
                agreementChart.data.labels.shift();
                agreementChart.data.datasets[0].data.shift();
                queueChart.data.labels.shift();
                queueChart.data.datasets[0].data.shift();
            }
            
            responseTimeChart.update('none');
            agreementChart.update('none');
            queueChart.update('none');
        }
        
        function testPrediction() {
            // Simulate a test prediction
            const shadowProcessed = Math.random() < (deploymentData.shadowRate / 100);
            
            if (shadowProcessed) {
                const prodPrediction = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
                const shadowPrediction = Math.random() < 0.95 ? prodPrediction : Math.floor(Math.random() * 10);
                const prodConfidence = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3;
                const shadowConfidence = prodConfidence + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1;
                const prodTime = deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgResponseTime + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
                const shadowTime = deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgResponseTime + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15;
                
                alert(`Test Prediction Result:\\n\\nProduction: ${prodPrediction} (conf: ${prodConfidence.toFixed(3)}, time: ${prodTime.toFixed(1)}ms)\\nShadow: ${shadowPrediction} (conf: ${shadowConfidence.toFixed(3)}, time: ${shadowTime.toFixed(1)}ms)\\n\\nMatch: ${prodPrediction === shadowPrediction ? 'Yes' : 'No'}\\nShadow Processed: Yes`);
                
                // Update metrics
                deploymentData.totalRequests++;
                deploymentData.shadowRequests++;
                
                if (prodPrediction === shadowPrediction) {
                    deploymentData.matchingPredictions++;
                } else {
                    deploymentData.disagreements++;
                }
                
                deploymentData.agreementRate = (deploymentData.matchingPredictions / (deploymentData.matchingPredictions + deploymentData.disagreements)) * 100;
            } else {
                alert('Test Prediction Result:\\n\\nProduction prediction completed\\nShadow: Not processed (traffic sampling)');
                deploymentData.totalRequests++;
            }
            
            updateDashboard();
        }
        
        function generateReport() {
            const report = `
Shadow Deployment Analysis Report
Generated: ${new Date().toLocaleString()}

=== DEPLOYMENT SUMMARY ===
Name: ${deploymentData.name}
Status: ${deploymentData.status.toUpperCase()}
Duration: ${deploymentData.duration.toFixed(1)} hours
Total Requests: ${deploymentData.totalRequests.toLocaleString()}
Shadow Requests: ${deploymentData.shadowRequests.toLocaleString()}

=== PERFORMANCE COMPARISON ===
Production Model:
  - Avg Response Time: ${deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgResponseTime}ms
  - Avg Confidence: ${deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgConfidence.toFixed(3)}
  - P95 Response Time: ${deploymentData.productionMetrics.p95ResponseTime}ms

Shadow Model:
  - Avg Response Time: ${deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgResponseTime}ms
  - Avg Confidence: ${deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgConfidence.toFixed(3)}
  - P95 Response Time: ${deploymentData.shadowMetrics.p95ResponseTime}ms

=== PREDICTION ANALYSIS ===
Agreement Rate: ${deploymentData.agreementRate.toFixed(1)}%
Matching Predictions: ${deploymentData.matchingPredictions.toLocaleString()}
Disagreements: ${deploymentData.disagreements.toLocaleString()}
Avg Confidence Difference: ${deploymentData.avgConfidenceDiff.toFixed(3)}

=== RECOMMENDATION ===
${deploymentData.recommendation}

=== NEXT STEPS ===
Based on the analysis, consider:
1. Reviewing disagreement patterns for edge cases
2. Performance optimization if response time impact is concerning
3. Gradual rollout planning if recommendation is positive
4. Extended analysis period for more confidence
            `;
            
            // Create and download report
            const blob = new Blob([report], { type: 'text/plain' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `shadow_deployment_report_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.txt`;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            
            alert('Analysis report downloaded!');
        }
        
        function pauseShadowing() {
            if (deploymentData.status === 'active') {
                deploymentData.status = 'analyzing';
                deploymentData.shadowRate = 0;
                alert('Shadow processing paused. Analysis mode activated.');
            } else {
                deploymentData.status = 'active';
                deploymentData.shadowRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('shadow-slider').value);
                alert('Shadow processing resumed.');
            }
            updateDashboard();
        }
        
        function stopDeployment() {
            if (confirm('Are you sure you want to stop the shadow deployment?')) {
                deploymentData.status = 'completed';
                deploymentData.shadowRate = 0;
                alert('Shadow deployment stopped. Final analysis available.');
                updateDashboard();
            }
        }
        
        function updateShadowPercentage(value) {
            document.getElementById('shadow-value').textContent = value + '%';
            
            if (deploymentData.status === 'active') {
                deploymentData.shadowRate = parseFloat(value);
                updateDashboard();
            }
        }
        
        // Simulate real-time updates
        function simulateUpdates() {
            if (deploymentData.status === 'active') {
                // Simulate incoming requests
                const newRequests = Math.floor(Math.random() * 20) + 5;
                const shadowRequests = Math.floor(newRequests * deploymentData.shadowRate / 100);
                
                deploymentData.totalRequests += newRequests;
                deploymentData.shadowRequests += shadowRequests;
                
                // Simulate queue changes
                deploymentData.queueSize += Math.floor((Math.random() - 0.5) * 10);
                deploymentData.queueSize = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, deploymentData.queueSize));
                
                // Simulate metric variations
                deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgResponseTime += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
                deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgResponseTime += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3;
                deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgConfidence += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
                deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgConfidence += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.01;
                
                // Keep values in reasonable ranges
                deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgResponseTime = Math.max(30, Math.min(80, deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgResponseTime));
                deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgResponseTime = Math.max(35, Math.min(100, deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgResponseTime));
                deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgConfidence = Math.max(0.7, Math.min(1.0, deploymentData.productionMetrics.avgConfidence));
                deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgConfidence = Math.max(0.7, Math.min(1.0, deploymentData.shadowMetrics.avgConfidence));
                
                // Simulate some prediction matches/mismatches
                const newMatches = Math.floor(shadowRequests * 0.95);
                const newDisagreements = shadowRequests - newMatches;
                
                deploymentData.matchingPredictions += newMatches;
                deploymentData.disagreements += newDisagreements;
                deploymentData.agreementRate = (deploymentData.matchingPredictions / (deploymentData.matchingPredictions + deploymentData.disagreements)) * 100;

def create_sample_models_for_shadow():
    """Create sample models for shadow deployment testing."""
    
    # Production model - current stable version
    production_model = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Linear(784, 256),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Dropout(0.2),
        nn.Linear(256, 128),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Linear(128, 10)
    )
    
    # Shadow model - new version with different architecture
    shadow_model = nn.Sequential(
        nn.Linear(784, 512),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
        nn.Dropout(0.3),
        nn.Linear(512, 256),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
        nn.Dropout(0.2),
        nn.Linear(256, 128),
        nn.ReLU(),
        nn.Linear(128, 10)
    )
    
    # Save models
    torch.save(production_model.state_dict(), "production_model.pt")
    torch.save(shadow_model.state_dict(), "shadow_model.pt")
    
    # Create TorchScript versions
    production_model.eval()
    shadow_model.eval()
    
    example_input = torch.randn(1, 784)
    
    traced_production = torch.jit.trace(production_model, example_input)
    traced_shadow = torch.jit.trace(shadow_model, example_input)
    
    traced_production.save("production_model_traced.pt")
    traced_shadow.save("shadow_model_traced.pt")
    
    logger.info("Sample models created for shadow deployment")
    return "production_model_traced.pt", "shadow_model_traced.pt"

async def run_shadow_deployment_simulation():
    """Run a complete shadow deployment simulation."""
    
    print("=== Shadow Deployment Simulation ===")
    
    # Create sample models
    production_path, shadow_path = create_sample_models_for_shadow()
    
    # Create shadow configuration
    config = ShadowConfig(
        deployment_id="shadow_v3_0",
        name="Shadow Model v3.0 Analysis",
        production_model_path=production_path,
        shadow_model_path=shadow_path,
        shadow_traffic_percentage=100.0,  # Shadow all traffic
        comparison_metrics=["response_time", "confidence", "prediction_agreement"],
        analysis_window_hours=24,
        min_sample_size=100,  # Low for demo
        max_duration_hours=168,
        enable_performance_comparison=True,
        enable_prediction_comparison=True
    )
    
    # Create and start deployment
    deployment = ShadowDeployment(config)
    await deployment.start_deployment()
    
    print(f"Started shadow deployment: {config.name}")
    print(f"Shadow traffic percentage: {config.shadow_traffic_percentage}%")
    
    # Simulate user requests
    users = [f"user_{i}" for i in range(100)]
    
    print("\nSimulating user requests...")
    try:
        for i in range(500):  # Simulate 500 requests
            user_id = np.random.choice(users)
            test_data = np.random.randn(784)
            request_id = f"req_{i}_{user_id}"
            
            try:
                result = await deployment.predict(test_data, user_id, request_id)
                
                if (i + 1) % 100 == 0:
                    print(f"  Completed {i + 1} requests")
                    status = deployment.get_deployment_status()
                    print(f"  Status: {status['status']}")
                    print(f"  Total requests: {status['total_requests']}")
                    print(f"  Shadow requests: {status['traffic_stats']['shadow_requests']}")
                    if status['analysis'].get('status') != 'insufficient_data':
                        print(f"  Agreement rate: {status['analysis']['prediction_comparison']['prediction_agreement_rate']:.2%}")
                
                # Small delay to simulate realistic request timing
                await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
                
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  Error in request {i}: {e}")
        
        # Wait for shadow processing to complete
        print("\nWaiting for shadow processing to complete...")
        await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for async processing
        
        # Get final analysis
        final_status = deployment.get_deployment_status()
        detailed_analysis = deployment.get_detailed_analysis()
        
        print(f"\nFinal Shadow Deployment Analysis:")
        print(f"Status: {final_status['status']}")
        print(f"Duration: {final_status['duration_hours']:.2f} hours")
        print(f"Total requests: {final_status['total_requests']}")
        print(f"Shadow requests: {final_status['traffic_stats']['shadow_requests']}")
        
        if detailed_analysis['performance_analysis'].get('status') != 'insufficient_data':
            perf_analysis = detailed_analysis['performance_analysis']
            
            print(f"\nPerformance Comparison:")
            print(f"  Production avg response time: {perf_analysis['performance_comparison']['production_avg_response_time']:.1f}ms")
            print(f"  Shadow avg response time: {perf_analysis['performance_comparison']['shadow_avg_response_time']:.1f}ms")
            print(f"  Response time difference: {perf_analysis['performance_comparison']['response_time_difference']:.1f}ms")
            
            print(f"\nPrediction Analysis:")
            print(f"  Agreement rate: {perf_analysis['prediction_comparison']['prediction_agreement_rate']:.2%}")
            print(f"  Avg confidence difference: {perf_analysis['prediction_comparison']['avg_confidence_difference']:.4f}")
            print(f"  Production avg confidence: {perf_analysis['prediction_comparison']['production_avg_confidence']:.4f}")
            print(f"  Shadow avg confidence: {perf_analysis['prediction_comparison']['shadow_avg_confidence']:.4f}")
            
            print(f"\nRecommendation: {perf_analysis['summary']['recommendation']}")
        
        pattern_analysis = detailed_analysis.get('pattern_analysis', {})
        if pattern_analysis.get('status') != 'insufficient_data':
            print(f"\nPrediction Pattern Analysis:")
            print(f"  Agreement cases: {pattern_analysis['agreement_cases']}")
            print(f"  Disagreement cases: {pattern_analysis['disagreement_cases']}")
            print(f"  Avg confidence diff (agree): {pattern_analysis['avg_confidence_diff_when_agree']:.4f}")
            print(f"  Avg confidence diff (disagree): {pattern_analysis['avg_confidence_diff_when_disagree']:.4f}")
        
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\nSimulation interrupted by user")
    
    finally:
        # Stop deployment
        await deployment.stop_deployment()
        print("Shadow deployment stopped")
    
    return deployment
